cornerstone.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p266. Decisive wording: 'during the period commencing from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six (6) months after the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”)'. Explicit inclusive END: last restricted day = 2026-06-23 + 6m = 2026-12-23, first free day = 2026-12-24. The candidate's notes even state 'restricted period inclusive of both the Listing Date and the date falling six months after' but computed the anniversary-exclusive dates (2026-12-23/2026-12-22) - corrected per convention.

corrections.basis: restricted period commencing on (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (2026-06-23) and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six (6) months after the Listing Date (2026-12-23); both endpoints expressly inclusive, so first free day is the day after the inclusive end

controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p298. 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' - explicit inclusive end: 2026-06-23 + 6m = 2026-12-23 last restricted, first free 2026-12-24. Matches candidate.

controller_12m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p298; the clause breaks mid-sentence and the continuation on p299 is confirmed verbatim: 'Relevant Shares to such extent that, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, he/it would then cease to be the Controlling Shareholders of the Company for the purpose of the Listing Rules.' Second six-month period from expiry of the First -> ends 12 months from Listing Date 2027-06-23 (inclusive) -> first free 2027-06-24. Matches candidate. PRC Company Law 12-month lock-up on all current shares (p150) is statutory, out of slot scope.
